thread:
maria_garcia: Quick draft of rollout approach for traffic-slicing + fast-fallbacks. Want feedback before we lock rollout playbook. TL;DR: feature-flag gate, 1% canary -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% by region, automated rollback triggers, A/B metric guardrails, fallback to smaller model variant or degraded response mode. Thoughts?

aj_chen: Love the structure. Couple Qs: how long between steps? and do we do regional stagger or simultaneous across regions?

maria_garcia: Plan is regional stagger: start us-west, then eu-west, then apac. Wait 4 hours at 1% then 12h at 5% -> 48h at 20% before global. But can be shortened if healthy signals show stable.

simon_kapoor: Agree with staged regions. Add one more constraint: if a top-5 customer in a region has active traffic, pause per-customer opt-in check before promoting. We need manual override for enterprise tenants.

leah_wong: How are we encoding the feature flag? example config?

maria_garcia: Pasted sample flag config below (for ops/devex to verify):
```
flag: rollout/v2-inference-routing
enabled: true
regions:
  - name: us-west
    phases:
      - percent: 1
        duration: 4h
      - percent: 5
        duration: 12h
      - percent: 20
        duration: 48h
fallbacks:
  - type: model_variant
    variant: small-quant
    trigger: error_rate > 2% OR p95_latency_ms > 1200
  - type: degraded_mode
    description: respond-with-short-summary
    trigger: 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m
```

aj_chen: Nice. Suggest adding an automated canary analysis job to compute risk score and post to the channel. If risk_score > 0.7 -> fail promotion.

devex_bot: canary-analysis job scheduled: canary_job/v2-routing at promotion checkpoints -> outputs: error_rate, p50/p95 latency, token-cost-delta, user-facing-quality-delta.

maria_garcia: Good call. We should also tie to A/B evaluation for quality: run 10k rand users through experiment variant vs control and compute embedding-similarity + manual spot-checks for hallucination rate. If quality metric delta > 2% degrade, block.

simon_kapoor: Operational rollback thresholds: error_rate > 2% OR p95 increase > 30% OR token-cost increase > 40% sustained for 10 minutes. If any trigger, automatic rollback to previous model variant + alert paging. Manual review required before re-promote.

leah_wong: Who gets paged?

simon_kapoor: Pager goes to eng-oncall + product on-call + customer-success for impacted enterprise accounts. Also post summary to #product-rollouts.

aj_chen: A/B specifics: run 50/50 split for 72h only for non-authenticated/anonymous flows where sampling is feasible. Need a minimum sample size rule: N >= 10k requests per arm. If low traffic, extend window.

maria_garcia: Agree. For enterprise customers we'll do targeted canaries with explicit opt-in and manual signoff. No automatic promotion for enterprise traffic.

leah_wong: What about fallback routing when model variant isn't compatible? e.g., quantized variant changes output format?

maria_garcia: Good point. Add compatibility check step pre-promotion: smoke tests (schema, tool-calls, function-calling), and a subset of synthetic prompts. If schema mismatch -> immediate block and route to safe-fallback which returns controlled error advising retry.

devex_bot: smoke-tests executed: schema-check, function-call-retain, tool-compat. All pass for current build.

aj_chen: How do we surface cost signals? We need token-cost delta in dashboard and a daily alert if expected per-token cost exceeds baseline by >20% post-rollout. Also allow an automatic throttle to smaller-variant if cost > threshold and no quality regression detected.

maria_garcia: We'll add a cost monitor policy: if token-cost-delta > 30% for 1h AND quality_delta <= 1% -> auto-fallback to small-quant for affected routes. Documented in playbook.

leah_wong: Playbook needs a short checklist for on-call: "when alerted, check canary job, inspect top error traces, confirm customer impact, decide rollback or proceed" — can we add that?

maria_garcia: Yep, I'll draft the checklist. Quick version: 1) open canary dashboard, 2) run smoke-tests, 3) inspect sample responses, 4) ack or rollback, 5) post incident note.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created: rollout/v2-inference-routing -> start: us-west -> 1792349000 (ETA).

aj_chen: One more request: flag decay and feature-flag naming. Ensure flags include owner, ticket link, and revoke window.

maria_garcia: Will add metadata: owner=@maria_garcia, trello/issue: PROD-4123, revoke_at: 2026-07-01 (auto-disable if not promoted).

leah_wong: Anything else for GA criteria?

maria_garcia: GA = promoted to all regions for >=7 days with <0.5% regressions on quality metrics, SLAs met (p95 latency < 800ms), and cost delta within agreed bounds. Must have docs, playbook, and customer comms drafted.

aj_chen: Sounds good. I'll incorporate into the launch checklist and add step to schedule a 30m dry-run with SRE next week.

maria_garcia: Thanks all. Action items: @aj_chen update flag schema and canary job, @leah_wong draft playbook checklist, @simon_kapoor add pager routing + rollback automation, @devex_bot run final smoke-tests and post results. I'll update the ticket with this thread. :thumbsup:

devex_bot: smoke-tests: final run complete, results posted -> link: https://internal.redwood/test-results/rollout-v2 (summary: pass).

maria_garcia: Perfect. If no objections by EOD I'll mark the playbook ready for ops to schedule the canary.

aj_chen: No objections from me. :+1:

simon_kapoor: No objections.

leah_wong: All good.

ops_bot: Note: will pause auto-promote if enterprise opt-in active for region.

maria_garcia: Closing thread for now — thanks everyone.
